description: The plot illustrates training loss trajectories over optimization iterations for multiple model variants, with several colored lines overlaid and a legend identifying “Vanilla,” “StrmLLM (n=64),” and several “SepLLM” configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” appears linear, and spans from 0 to about 140,000, with labeled ticks at regular 20,000-iteration intervals (0, 20,000, 40,000, …, 140,000). The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” appears linear, and spans roughly from about 2.4 up to about 3.4, with tick labels at approximately 0.1 increments. Each series is drawn as a solid line with a faint shaded band around it (indicating variability), and all curves show a steep initial decrease from near the top of the y-range at iteration 0 to a minimum around the early part of training (roughly in the 10k–30k iteration region), followed by a gradual upward drift through the remainder of the x-range: the purple “Vanilla” line drops to around the high-2.6/low-2.7 region and ends near the low-2.8s by ~140k; the light-blue “StrmLLM (n=64)” line drops to around the high-2.8s and then rises gradually to just under about 3.0 by ~140k; the orange “SepLLM (n=64)” line drops to around the mid/high-2.7s and ends around the mid/high-2.8s; the green “SepLLM (n=64, H)” line follows a similar pattern, bottoming in the high-2.6/low-2.7 region and ending in the mid/high-2.8s; the red “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” line drops to around the mid/high-2.6s and ends around the low/mid-2.8s; and the dark-blue “SepLLM (n=128)” line also drops into the high-2.6/low-2.7 region and finishes around the low/mid-2.8s by the right edge of the plot.
